title: 7 Days on Gratitude
description: Cultivate a heart of thankfulness, even in hard seasons, through a week of Scripture and reflection.

days.verseText: In every thing give thanks: for this is the will of God in Christ Jesus concerning you.
days.reflection: What is one thing today you can thank God for, even in a hard season?
days.habitSuggestion: Write down 3 things you're grateful for before bed.

days.verseText: O give thanks unto the LORD, for he is good: for his mercy endureth for ever.
days.reflection: Where have you seen God's goodness this week, even in something small?
days.habitSuggestion: Thank God out loud for one specific blessing before you eat today.

days.verseText: Be careful for nothing; but in every thing by prayer and supplication with thanksgiving let your requests be made known unto God.
days.reflection: What worry are you carrying that you could bring to God with thanksgiving instead of anxiety?
days.habitSuggestion: Turn one worry into a prayer of thanks today.

days.verseText: And let the peace of God rule in your hearts, to the which also ye are called in one body; and be ye thankful.
days.reflection: Is there a relationship in your life you've taken for granted? How can you show thankfulness for it today?
days.habitSuggestion: Send a message thanking someone who has shaped your faith or your life.

days.verseText: Enter into his gates with thanksgiving, and into his courts with praise: be thankful unto him, and bless his name.
days.reflection: What would it look like to start your prayer time with praise instead of requests today?
days.habitSuggestion: Begin your prayer today with two minutes of praise before asking for anything.

days.verseText: O give thanks unto the LORD; for he is good; for his mercy endureth for ever.
days.reflection: Where have you experienced God's mercy recently — a second chance, a quiet relief, an undeserved kindness?
days.habitSuggestion: Journal about one time God showed you mercy this year.

days.verseText: Every good gift and every perfect gift is from above, and cometh down from the Father of lights, with whom is no variableness, neither shadow of turning.
days.reflection: Looking back on this week, what good gift from God stands out most clearly to you now?
days.habitSuggestion: Make a list of 7 good gifts God has given you — one for each day of this plan.

title: 7 Days on Prayer
description: Deepen your conversation with God through a week of Scripture on what it means to pray.

days.verseText: But thou, when thou prayest, enter into thy closet, and when thou hast shut thy door, pray to thy Father which is in secret; and thy Father which seeth in secret shall reward thee openly.
days.reflection: Do you have a quiet, private place and time set aside for prayer? What would it take to create one?
days.habitSuggestion: Find 5 quiet minutes today to pray somewhere private, without distractions.

days.verseText: And this is the confidence that we have in him, that, if we ask any thing according to his will, he heareth us.
days.reflection: What confidence do you have — or struggle to have — that God actually hears you when you pray?
days.habitSuggestion: Pray one request today and intentionally thank God in advance for hearing you.

days.verseText: Confess your faults one to another, and pray one for another, that ye may be healed. The effectual fervent prayer of a righteous man availeth much.
days.reflection: Is there someone in your life you could pray for today, or pray together with?
days.habitSuggestion: Text or call someone and pray for a need they're facing.

days.verseText: Ask, and it shall be given you; seek, and ye shall find; knock, and it shall be opened unto you.
days.reflection: What have you been hesitant to ask God for? What's holding you back?
days.habitSuggestion: Bring one bold request to God in prayer today.

days.verseText: Pray without ceasing.
days.reflection: What would it look like to weave short prayers into the ordinary moments of today — commuting, cooking, waiting?
days.habitSuggestion: Offer a short, silent prayer during three ordinary moments today.

days.verseText: Therefore I say unto you, What things soever ye desire, when ye pray, believe that ye receive them, and ye shall have them.
days.reflection: Where is your faith weak when you pray — do you expect God to actually move?
days.habitSuggestion: Pray for one specific thing today with deliberate, expectant faith.

days.verseText: Call unto me, and I will answer thee, and shew thee great and mighty things, which thou knowest not.
days.reflection: Looking back on this week of prayer, what has shifted in how you talk to God?
days.habitSuggestion: Write down one answered prayer — big or small — from this past week.

title: 7 Days on Trusting God
description: Learn to rest in God's faithfulness when life feels uncertain, through a week of Scripture and reflection.

days.verseText: Trust in the LORD with all thine heart; and lean not unto thine own understanding. In all thy ways acknowledge him, and he shall direct thy paths.
days.reflection: Where are you currently leaning on your own understanding instead of trusting God?
days.habitSuggestion: Name one decision you're facing and hand it over to God in prayer today.

days.verseText: Fear thou not; for I am with thee: be not dismayed; for I am thy God: I will strengthen thee; yea, I will help thee; yea, I will uphold thee with the right hand of my righteousness.
days.reflection: What fear are you facing right now that you need God's strength for?
days.habitSuggestion: Speak this verse out loud over your biggest fear today.

days.verseText: What time I am afraid, I will trust in thee.
days.reflection: What's your instinct when fear rises — to control, to worry, or to trust?
days.habitSuggestion: The next time you feel anxious today, pause and pray this verse.

days.verseText: And we know that all things work together for good to them that love God, to them who are the called according to his purpose.
days.reflection: Can you look back on a hard season and see how God worked good from it?
days.habitSuggestion: Journal about a past hardship where you can now see God's hand.

days.verseText: For I know the thoughts that I think toward you, saith the LORD, thoughts of peace, and not of evil, to give you an expected end.
days.reflection: Do you believe God's plans for you are good, even when circumstances say otherwise?
days.habitSuggestion: Thank God for a good future you can't yet see.

days.verseText: God is our refuge and strength, a very present help in trouble.
days.reflection: Where do you tend to run for comfort when trouble comes — and is it God?
days.habitSuggestion: Bring today's trouble, big or small, straight to God before anyone else.

days.verseText: Thou wilt keep him in perfect peace, whose mind is stayed on thee: because he trusteth in thee.
days.reflection: Looking back on this week, how has your trust in God grown?
days.habitSuggestion: Write a short prayer committing to keep your mind stayed on God this coming week.
